rows.predecessor_quote: Missing, duplicate, shadowed, or unknown record kinds and populations fail closed.
rows.successor_quote: Missing, duplicate, shadowed or unknown record kinds and populations fail closed (P3, P5; rc.2 #ac-001-closed-signature).

rows.predecessor_quote: An identity resolves one member under one type, context, owner, scope, and basis.
rows.successor_quote: So an identity resolves one member under one type, context, owner, scope and basis.
rows.what_changed: Grounds the rule in IDENTITY §2 and FOUNDATIONS §2 and widens 'graph position' to 'position in any structure'; the resolution rule and the non-identity list are restated in full.

rows.predecessor_quote: Every referenced identity resolves exactly once in the applicable model or through one explicit external relation.
rows.successor_quote: Every referenced identity resolves exactly once in the applicable model or through one explicit external relation.

rows.predecessor_quote: Direction is material unless the relation kind explicitly declares symmetry.
rows.successor_quote: Direction is material unless the relation kind explicitly declares symmetry (P4a, P3; rc.2 #ac-004-relation-typing).

rows.predecessor_quote: Copying, interpreting, encoding, evaluating, or transporting a record does not transfer authority.
rows.successor_quote: its instances are copying, interpreting, encoding, evaluating and transporting a record, none of which transfers authority
rows.what_changed: Names the four authority kinds as FOUNDATIONS §2's and the five handling acts as a_c instances of its no-authority list; both determinations restated.

rows.predecessor_quote: Every fundamental record, model, and result binds an exact basis. Mixed bases require an explicitly owned composite-basis relation.
rows.successor_quote: Every result binds its exact basis under RF-005 ... including that mixed bases need an explicit composite relation, is FOUNDATIONS §2, Basis.
rows.what_changed: Records and models keep the full rule. For results the locus states only the exact basis (RF-005) and an explicit composite relation (FOUNDATIONS §2); that the composite relation is owned is not in the given text.
rows.counterexample: Undecided: a result over a mixed basis whose composite-basis relation is declared but has no owner. rc.2 makes it unlawful; the given successor text does not decide.
rows.smallest_repair: Supply FOUNDATIONS §2 Basis and RF-005; if neither requires an owner, extend the explicitly owned composite-basis clause to results.

rows.predecessor_quote: A failed, missing, indeterminate, out-of-scope, or invalid-basis result follows the declared result algebra rather than being coerced to success.
rows.successor_quote: A missing result is no value of this refinement: a judgment that was not performed has no closed result, is never `indeterminate`
rows.what_changed: No-coercion and the five named parts are conserved. The successor fixes mappings rc.2 left to its declared algebra: out of scope to out_of_frame; a missing result is no value, a gap, never indeterminate. rc.2's algebra is not given.
rows.counterexample: Undecided: an owning signature records a not-performed constraint judgment as indeterminate, or maps an out-of-scope subject to invalid_basis. The successor forbids both; rc.2 forbade them only if its declared algebra did.
rows.smallest_repair: Supply rc.2 RF-012 and the rc.2 judgment-kind result contract, or record a replacement relation for the missing-result and out-of-scope mappings.

rows.predecessor_quote: Two values may differ lawfully only through an applicable latitude or transformation relation.
rows.successor_quote: Two values may differ lawfully only through an applicable latitude record or transformation relation.

rows.predecessor_quote: Absence from a projection is not resolution.
rows.successor_quote: Absence from a projection is not resolution (P4b; rc.2 #ac-009-residual-conservation).

rows.predecessor_quote: Failure to establish those conditions returns a gap or refusal.
rows.successor_quote: Failure to establish those conditions returns a gap or refusal: `gap` where a condition is unresolved on the basis, otherwise `refusal(basis)`
rows.what_changed: Fixes which stop applies (gap for a condition unresolved on the basis, otherwise refusal(basis)); both remain stops with core value invalid_basis, so no closure decision changes.

rows.predecessor_quote: A projection is not a new semantic owner and cannot silently trim a required member to satisfy a carrier or capability budget.
rows.successor_quote: no reference trims a required member to fit a carrier or budget ... here the required members are those of the material closure of `Z`
rows.what_changed: Trimming prohibition applied from FOUNDATIONS §4 Reference versus body with required members fixed as the closure of Z; stops narrowed to the closure's or model's gap or refusal(basis). No decision altered.

rows.predecessor_quote: An overlay adds explicit records to one or more declared `Population_M` families of a basis model. It does not mutate the basis.
rows.successor_quote: An overlay adds explicit records to one or more declared `Population_M` families of a basis model. It does not mutate the basis.

rows.predecessor_quote: Issuing a judgment does not transform, rewrite, reissue, or rename its subject.
rows.successor_quote: Issuing a judgment does not transform, rewrite, reissue or rename its subject.

rows.predecessor_quote: Applying any `F_*` kind without bracketed traversal identity `[v]` is incomplete.
rows.successor_quote: Such an application violates this law, and its outcome is `refusal(constraint)` under AC-007
rows.what_changed: Binding law unchanged. rc.2 gives the absent-[v] case only the outcome 'incomplete'; the successor makes it refusal(constraint), falsified, and excludes the step-stop reading. What rc.2's 'incomplete' entailed is not in the given text.
rows.counterexample: Undecided: an F_D application recorded without [v] and later completed by binding [v]. The successor has already returned refusal(constraint), falsified; rc.2's 'incomplete' may have held it open as a pending stop.
rows.smallest_repair: Supply rc.2's meaning of 'incomplete' for a functor application and the rc.2 result algebra, or record a replacement relation for the refusal(constraint) outcome.

rows.predecessor_quote: `a_c` prescribes no universal `F_P -> F_D -> F_H` sequence; each application owns its lawful topology.
rows.successor_quote: `a_c` prescribes no universal `F_P -> F_D -> F_H` sequence; each application owns its lawful topology (P4a, P4b, P6).

rows.predecessor_quote: Interpretation cannot treat absence as immateriality without a recorded basis and authority.
rows.successor_quote: Interpretation cannot treat absence as immateriality without a recorded basis and authority (P1, P4b, P6; rc.2 #ac-017-interpretation-fidelity).

rows.predecessor_quote: Structural success is evidence for semantic review, not a substitute for it.
rows.successor_quote: the rule that structural success is evidence for semantic review and no substitute for it, are EVALUATION §2's ... This law binds them to `a_c`
rows.what_changed: Ownership of the separation moves to EVALUATION §2 for every review; the successor restates the rule and binds it to a_c with the same coverage, so the decision is unchanged.

rows.predecessor_quote: No generic checker may claim the semantic or authority subset unless the model supplies an exact lawful decision contract for it.
rows.successor_quote: No generic checker may claim the semantic or authority subset unless the model supplies an exact lawful decision contract for it (P6, P1).

rows.predecessor_quote: An encoding failure does not change `a_c.X`. An interpretation failure does not change `a_c`. A downstream success cannot ratify an upstream layer or basis.
rows.successor_quote: An encoding failure does not change `a_c.X`. An interpretation failure does not change `a_c`. A downstream success cannot ratify an upstream layer or basis.

rows.predecessor_quote: The downstream identity is never embedded back into the calculus or its publication basis.
rows.successor_quote: The downstream identity is never embedded back into the calculus or its publication basis (P2, P6; rc.2 #application-boundary).

rows.predecessor_quote: No example, checker, model, or carrier can qualify a law outside the exact claim it evaluates.
rows.successor_quote: No example, checker, model or carrier can qualify a law outside the exact claim it evaluates (P6; EVALUATION §1).

rows.predecessor_quote: A predicate that is not deterministically decidable states the required probabilistic or human judgment kind rather than pretending to be a machine proof.
rows.successor_quote: A predicate that is not deterministically decidable states the required probabilistic or human judgment kind rather than pretending to be a machine proof (P6, P1).

rows.predecessor_quote: A carrier may use records, tables, graphs, terms, clauses, code, or another representation only when its encoding profile proves that every tuple relation is preserved
rows.successor_quote: A carrier may use records, tables, terms, clauses, code or any other representation only when its encoding profile proves that every tuple relation is preserved
rows.what_changed: 'graphs' dropped from the carrier list but covered by 'any other representation'; the 'where' list becomes prose; every signature, population, reference-domain and refusal rule is restated verbatim.

rows.predecessor_quote: Issuance of an exact `AxiomaticCalculusBasis` resolves and records their absolute predecessor-cut semantic addresses under `derivation_basis.release_uri`.
rows.successor_quote: Issuance of an exact `AxiomaticCalculusBasis` (§8) resolves and records their absolute predecessor-cut semantic addresses under `derivation_basis.principle_refs`.
rows.what_changed: Nine derivation families keep their rc.2 clauses, now with successor loci. The issuance sentence names principle_refs instead of release_uri; the unchanged schema and identity section already put clause addresses in principle_refs, inside that release.

rows.predecessor_quote: An exact released calculus basis is an external record created after the publication bytes exist.
rows.successor_quote: An exact released calculus basis is an external record created after the publication bytes exist.
rows.what_changed: Adds 'Binding of this edition': issuance under RELEASE and AC-020 after release bytes exist, authoring text never identity-bearing, rc.2 coordinates as provenance. Record shape and rules unchanged.

rows.predecessor_quote: a required graph storage topology; a world-model ontology;
rows.successor_quote: a required storage topology of any shape; an ontology of any domain;
rows.what_changed: Two exclusions generalised (any storage topology, any domain ontology); each contains its predecessor case and contradicts no predecessor affirmation.

rows.predecessor_quote: It neither changes `a_c` nor enters this standard by being useful to an application.
rows.successor_quote: It neither changes `a_c` nor enters this member by being useful to an application

rows.predecessor_quote: The proposed model `M_subject*` does not become accepted through construction.
rows.successor_quote: The proposed model `M_subject*` does not become accepted through construction.
rows.what_changed: Adds that stops take core values under AC-007 and that the contract is FOUNDATIONS §2's Interpretation made exact; contract list, AC-017 and AC-019 verbatim, AC-018 as in its own row.

rows.predecessor_quote: Silence is not latitude. Latitude grants no authority beyond its owner, scope, basis, and invalidation law.
rows.successor_quote: Silence is not latitude. Latitude grants no authority beyond its owner, scope, basis and invalidation law

rows.predecessor_quote: `a_c` makes no claim of universal applicability, logical completeness, consistency, decidability, soundness, or category-theoretic status except where an exact, separately identified proof establishes that claim
rows.successor_quote: `a_c` claims no universal applicability, logical completeness, consistency, decidability, soundness or category-theoretic status except where an exact, separately identified proof establishes that claim
rows.what_changed: 'STDO's' becomes 'this method's'; identifiers declared carrier-independent; the category-theoretic proof is pointed at FOUNDATIONS §4 Formal fragment's demonstration. Layer, release and non-redefinition rules verbatim.

rows.predecessor_quote: Projection, compression, interpretation, or encoding cannot erase a residual.
rows.successor_quote: Projection, compression, interpretation or encoding cannot erase a residual.

rows.predecessor_quote: `a_c` does not choose the subject vocabulary, decide which source declarations are material, supply semantic acceptance, select a carrier, execute a model
rows.successor_quote: `a_c` does not choose the subject vocabulary, decide which source declarations are material, supply semantic acceptance, select a carrier, execute a model

rows.predecessor_quote: `id`, `sort`, `context`, `owner`, and `basis` are identities. `scope` is the closed governed domain.
rows.successor_quote: `id`, `sort`, `context`, `owner` and `basis` are identities. `scope` is the closed governed domain.

rows.predecessor_quote: Encoding requires `J_X.decision = accepted` and exact equality between the judgment subject identity and digest and `M_X`; hold or refusal cannot be encoded.
rows.successor_quote: Encoding requires `J_X.decision = accepted` and exact equality between the judgment subject identity and digest and `M_X`; hold or refusal cannot be encoded.
